name: pii_detect_benchmarking
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating models that detect personally identifiable information (PII) in text. It measures models' ability to locate and classify sensitive spans across diverse document types and redaction scenarios, supporting both token-level span detection and document-level classification.
reputation: Targeted at practitioners and researchers working on privacy and data-protection tooling; has practical adoption for PII detection benchmarking but is less prominent than major NLP leaderboards.
